div.head: Abt 20
div.ab: Gif man þone man ofslæhð, XX scillingum gebete.
Gif man þone man of slæhð, XX scillingum gebete.
If a person kills that man [who is being robbed] let him [i.e., the one who provided the weapons] pay with 20 shillings.
If the man is slain, [the lender of the weapons] shall pay 20 shillings compensation.
If, however, a man is killed, he is to pay 20 shillings compensation.
wenn man aber [damit] einen Menschen erschlägt, büsse [der Waffendarleiher an dessen Sippe] mit 20 Schillingen.
but if a person is slain [with them], let [the lender of the weapons] pay [to his kin] 20 shillings.
div.note: The man who provided the weapon.
